title: ImUi Debug Draw Stroke Style v1
problem: Close the first stroke-style follow-on above the IMUI debug-draw shape floor by adding explicit width/cap/join/miter/dash policy through `DebugDrawStrokeStyle`, while preserving the old thickness-based calls and keeping runtime and renderer contracts unchanged.

repro.summary: The IMUI debug-draw facade now exposes explicit stroke style policy for line, polyline, rect, triangle, and circle commands, including `StrokeStyleV2` cap/join/dash lowering when requested.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-kit --features imui debug_draw --no-fail-fast
